# `Q-12-19` — Listing `contents:` Pattern Matched Nothing

> A listing `contents:` pattern matched no project documents.

## What this means

A listing enumerates project documents matching its `contents:`
patterns. This warning fires when one pattern matched none of
them. Other patterns in the same listing still contribute their
items; a listing whose every pattern matches nothing renders
empty.

The check runs against the matched documents, before `include:` /
`exclude:` filters are applied — so this warning is about the
*pattern*, not about a filter that emptied the result.

## Why this happens

**`*` matches one directory level.** In Quarto 1 an unanchored
pattern searched the whole tree; in Quarto 2 it does not:

```yaml
listing:
  contents:
    - "*.qmd"          # siblings of this page
    - "posts/*.qmd"    # documents directly in posts/
    - "posts/**/*.qmd" # documents anywhere under posts/
    - posts            # same as above
```

**Patterns resolve against the file they are written in.** Front
matter resolves against the document's own directory,
`_metadata.yml` against that file's directory, and `_quarto.yml`
against the project root. A leading `/` anchors at the project
root from anywhere:

```yaml
# in sub/index.qmd — list the project-root posts/ directory
listing:
  contents:
    - "/posts/*.qmd"
```

**The documents are not in the render set.** A listing can only
show pages the project renders. Files excluded by
`project.render`, or whose name or directory starts with `_` or
`.`, never appear.

## How to fix

Check the pattern against the project layout, and against the
location of the file the pattern is written in. Add `**/` to
search subdirectories, or name a directory to include everything
beneath it.
